dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001258\_9](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001258) Category 4 during the period Feb 18 2026-Feb 20 2026 in Mauritius. The center of the storm was located near latitude -15.72 longitude 74.86. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
